svg.text: CPUEmu instruction atlas — every cell maps to one catalog entry.
AVX/AVX2 VEX decode, YMM state, 256-bit integer, gather
BMI1/2 extraction, deposit, multiply, variable shifts
Exceptions divide, access, illegal instruction, breakpoint, SEH
Source: docs/instruction-atlas.csv • Cells are catalog entries, not equal-sized encoding totals or a percentage of all historical x86.
